Name: Judea
Description: The southern region of the land in the days of Jesus: the province where He was born at Bethlehem, where John preached in the wilderness, and where crowds from Jerusalem and all Judea came to hear Him.
BiblicalSignificance: Judea is the stage of the Gospel story's southern half — birth, baptism, and the road to Jerusalem — and the name the Romans gave the land the prophets had called Judah.
